messages:
Maria P.: Quick sync — Q3 observability scope callout: we need to finalize which of the tracing hooks + cost breakdown items ship in the beta console rollout. Keeping this tight: dashboards (cost hotpaths), trace sampling hooks, and an error-analysis quickview. Thoughts?
Teja R.: agree on keeping beta small. can we defer full root-cause analysis UI to post-beta?
Samir K.: +1. Recommendation: ship dashboard templates + trace hook primitives (span-level tags + sampling controls) and a lightweight errors table with links to traces. That hits most enterprise asks without big infra work.
Olivia L.: what are the customer-driven asks that push timeline? Avery flagged two enterprise customers asking for token-level cost attribution and SLO-triggered trace retention.
Avery (sales): correct — ACME and FinCo both want SLO-triggered retention and a clear cost per-route view. they'll sign on dedicated if we can show predictable costing.
Maria P.: good to know. Can we quantify dev effort vs impact? prioritize by ARR.
Samir K.: rough sizing: dashboard templates (2 dev-weeks + 1 QA), trace hooks (4 dev-weeks + infra work), SLO-triggered retention (3 dev-weeks + policy engine change), token-level cost attribution (5 dev-weeks, touches billing).
Teja R.: so token-level attribution is the big one. Maybe do a phased approach: provide per-route/caller cost breakdown (easy) and mark token-level as opt-in advanced telemetry for Dedicated.
Olivia L.: that feels like a good negotiation — enterprise gets per-route breakdown in beta; token-level as dedicated add-on. keeps hosted roadmap clean.
Samir K.: on tracing hooks: implement sampling controls + span annotation API first. Example API snippet we can expose: ```json\nPOST /v1/trace-hooks\n{ \"route\": \"/generate\", \"sampling\": \"probabilistic\", \"sample_rate\": 0.02, \"annotate_spans\": [\"model_version\",\"route_cost\"] }\n```
Maria P.: love the sample. Need acceptance criteria: 1) dashboard templates render with real customer data; 2) trace hooks can be toggled per-route and persist policy; 3) error quickview surfaces top-10 error signatures + link to traces.
Avery (sales): can we add a note for sales collateral: show a mock cost breakdown screenshot and an SLA note for retention? customers want numbers.
Teja R.: agree. Ops: retention SLA note — can we support 30d/90d for traces depending on tier? ops-bot: Deploy policy stub created: retention-tier: [\"30d\",\"90d\",\"custom\"], default: \"30d\". See /infra/policies/trace_retention.
Samir K.: follow-ups: we need infra acceptance to ensure sampling + retention play nice with KV cache and prefix caching. I'll add a spike for that.
Maria P.: decision (quick): Beta scope = dashboard templates (cost hotpaths per-route), trace hooks (sampling + span annotations), error quickview (top signatures + trace links), per-route retention tiers. Defer token-level token attribution & full RCA UI to post-beta.
Olivia L.: capture risks: 1) billing accuracy for per-route breakdown, 2) trace storage cost under low-sample policies, 3) UX clarity around sampling that may confuse customers.
Samir K.: mitigation notes: add a warning banner in console about sampling; surface expected cost delta in the dashboard; make per-route breakdown eventual (lag up to 5 mins).
Avery (sales): action for me: prepare two customer-facing slides showing tradeoffs and proposed go/no-go checklist.
Teja R.: action: I'll own trace hook API spec + acceptance tests. Assigning 2 sprints.
Samir K.: action: infra spike + estimate for token-level attribution if we get fast customer commitment.
Maria P.: I'll update the roadmap doc and schedule a 30-min sync with Eng-Infra and Sales on Friday. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Avery (sales): +1, can you include a list of customers to contact for beta?
Maria P.: will do.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled infra maintenance tonight 22:00 UTC. Traces may be delayed ~15-30m.
Olivia L.: noted. One more ask: add launch gating criteria — must-have: billing reconciliation for per-route breakdown and trace retention policy validated in staging. Optional: token-level cost POC.
Maria P.: noted. I'll add gating criteria to the roadmap doc and drop the link when done. Thanks everyone.
